span.p:
0. DEDUP LAYER (when SELECT DISTINCT)
<entity>_ranked + <entity>_deduped
━━━━━━━━━━━
How are duplicates resolved?
• ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY all_cols)
• WHERE rn = 1 in a separate CTE
• Replaces every SELECT DISTINCT

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 138) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
1. SOURCE LAYER
<table>_prepared / <table>_filtered
━━━━━━━━━━━
What does this table expose?
• Bare columns + renames
• Single-source value transforms
(UPPER, TRIM, arithmetic)
• Single-table WHERE filters

div.style: color: rgb(88, 28, 135) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
2. JOINED LAYER
<entity>_joined
━━━━━━━━━━━
How do these tables relate?
• JOIN clauses
• Multi-source derivations
• No WHERE, no aggregation

div.style: color: rgb(120, 53, 15) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
3. FILTERED LAYER
<entity>_filtered
━━━━━━━━━━━
Which slice are we operating on?
• Cross-source WHERE predicates
• Fires only when joined
inherited any WHERE

div.style: color: rgb(124, 45, 18) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
4. AGGREGATED LAYER
<entity>_aggregated
━━━━━━━━━━━
What's the rollup?
• GROUP BY + aggregates only
• Reads single-table input
• No JOINs, no derivations,
no WHERE

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
5. BRANCH LAYER
<branch_tag> / <entity>_<n>
━━━━━━━━━━━
Which variant of the result?
• One CTE per UNION ALL branch
• Each branch fully layered
internally

div.style: color: rgb(127, 29, 29) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
6. FINAL SELECT
(top-level — no CTE)
━━━━━━━━━━━
How is the result formatted?
• CAST
• COALESCE / NULLIF / IFNULL
• CASE WHEN … THEN … ELSE …
• Constants / literals
• ORDER BY, LIMIT

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
💡 Each CTE answers ONE question.
A reader can stop at the layer they care about.
